effect.minecraft.absorption.desc: Grants you temporary additional yellow hearts, allowing you to take more hits.
effect.minecraft.bad_omen.desc: It's almost as if something bad might happen, maybe in a village, or perhaps a trial chamber?
effect.minecraft.blindness.desc: Impairs your vision and prevents sprinting.
effect.minecraft.conduit_power.desc: Provides you with oxygen underwater, night vision, and increases your mining speed.
effect.minecraft.darkness.desc: Impairs your vision with a pulsing fog.
effect.minecraft.fire_resistance.desc: Grants you immunity to fire damage.
effect.minecraft.glowing.desc: Makes you glow with an outline that is visible through blocks.
effect.minecraft.haste.desc: Increases your mining and attack speed.
effect.minecraft.health_boost.desc: Grants you temporary additional hearts, which are empty at first.
effect.minecraft.hero_of_the_village.des: You saved the village! Villagers now offer discounted trades.
effect.minecraft.infested.desc: Causes silverfish to sometimes spawn when taking damage.
effect.minecraft.instant_damage.desc: Hurts the living and heals the undead.
effect.minecraft.instant_health.desc: Heals the living and hurts the undead.
effect.minecraft.luck.desc: Increases your chances of receiving better loot.
effect.minecraft.mining_fatigue.desc: Decreases your mining and attack speed.
effect.minecraft.nausea.desc: You feel sick! Temporarily distorts your vision.
effect.minecraft.night_vision.desc: Allows you to see in darkness and underwater.
effect.minecraft.oozing.desc: Causes slimes to spawn when dying.
effect.minecraft.poison.desc: Damages you over time without killing you.
effect.minecraft.raid_omen.desc: Entering a village will trigger a raid.
effect.minecraft.regeneration.desc: Slowly regenerates your health over time.
effect.minecraft.trial_omen.desc: Triggers ominous trials in trial chambers.
effect.minecraft.unluck.desc: Decreases your chances of receiving better loot.
effect.minecraft.weaving.desc: Allows you to move more quickly through cobwebs.
effect.minecraft.wind_charged.desc: Causes a burst of wind when dying.
